title: Listening Practice Test 03 – Dining & Restaurants
description: Đề luyện Listening theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 26 câu: Part 1 (2) · Part 2 (6) · Part 3 (9, có câu hỏi hàm ý và biểu đồ) · Part 4 (9, có sơ đồ). Chủ đề: nhà hàng, ẩm thực, dịch vụ tiệc.

groups.transcript:
(A) A cook is washing some pans.
(B) Some customers are seated at a counter.
(C) A server is carrying a tray.
(D) A cook is preparing a meal.

options.A: A cook is washing some pans.
options.B: Some customers are seated at a counter.
options.C: A server is carrying a tray.
options.D: A cook is preparing a meal.

questions.explanation: Đầu bếp đứng sau quầy với chảo, nồi đang nấu → (D). Không rửa chảo (A), không có khách (B), không có người phục vụ bưng khay (C).

groups.transcript:
(A) Diners are eating on a patio.
(B) Umbrellas have been set up over some tables.
(C) Chairs are stacked beside a door.
(D) A server is folding an umbrella.

options.A: Diners are eating on a patio.
options.B: Umbrellas have been set up over some tables.
options.C: Chairs are stacked beside a door.
options.D: A server is folding an umbrella.

questions.explanation: Ô che nắng đã được dựng phía trên các bàn → (B) (bị động hoàn thành mô tả trạng thái). Ảnh không có người → loại (A), (D); ghế đặt quanh bàn chứ không chồng lên nhau → loại (C).

groups.transcript:
Would you prefer a table inside or on the terrace?
(A) It's on the menu.
(B) Yes, I'd prefer that.
(C) Inside, please. It's a bit windy.

options.C: Inside, please. It's a bit windy.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi lựa chọn (inside hay terrace) → chọn một vế kèm lý do. (B) câu hỏi lựa chọn không trả lời Yes/No; (A) không liên quan.

groups.transcript:
Who recommended this restaurant?
(A) My colleague in accounting.
(B) The seafood pasta.
(C) At seven thirty.

questions.explanation: Who → người: đồng nghiệp phòng kế toán. (B) là món ăn (trả lời What), (C) là thời gian (When).

groups.transcript:
How much should we leave for a tip?
(A) I'll leave at six.
(B) Fifteen percent is usual here.
(C) It was very helpful.

questions.explanation: How much → số tiền/mức: 15% là mức thường lệ. (A) lặp từ 'leave' với nghĩa khác (rời đi); (C) bẫy nghĩa 'tip' = lời khuyên.

groups.transcript:
Didn't you order the vegetable soup?
(A) In alphabetical order.
(B) Yes, but I changed my mind.
(C) It's very hot today.

options.B: Yes, but I changed my mind.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi phủ định kiểm tra thông tin → 'Có, nhưng tôi đổi ý rồi'. (A) bẫy từ 'order' (thứ tự); (C) liên tưởng 'soup' – 'hot'.

groups.transcript:
Let's have the team lunch at the new Thai place.
(A) She's on her lunch break.
(B) No, I haven't placed it.
(C) Good idea. I've heard great things about it.

options.C: Good idea. I've heard great things about it.

questions.explanation: 'Let's…' là lời đề nghị → đồng ý. (A) lặp 'lunch'; (B) bẫy âm 'place' (nhà hàng) – 'placed' (đặt).

groups.transcript:
When will the new menu be ready?
(A) The chef is still testing a few dishes.
(B) Yes, it's ready to eat.
(C) Two menus, please.

options.A: The chef is still testing a few dishes.

questions.explanation: Câu trả lời gián tiếp: đầu bếp vẫn đang thử món → chưa biết khi nào xong. (C) lặp 'menu'; (B) Wh- question không trả lời Yes, lặp 'ready'.

groups.transcript:
M: Good afternoon, Bella Vista Restaurant. How may I help you?
W: Hi, I'd like to reserve a table for twelve people this Saturday at seven. It's for my manager's retirement party.
M: Let me check. I'm sorry, the main dining room is fully booked at seven. But our private room upstairs is available, and it can seat up to fifteen guests.
W: That sounds even better. Is there an extra charge for the private room?
M: There's no charge if you order from our set menu. I can e-mail you the menu options right now.
W: Great, please do. I'll choose one and call you back tomorrow.

questions.explanation: 'I'd like to reserve a table for twelve people…' – reserve = book.

questions.content: What event is the woman planning?
questions.explanation: 'It's for my manager's retirement party.'

questions.content: What does the man offer to do?
questions.explanation: 'I can e-mail you the menu options right now.'

groups.transcript:
W: Marco, the fish delivery just arrived, but half of the salmon we ordered is missing.
M: Really? We have that big corporate lunch tomorrow, and salmon is the main dish.
W: I called the supplier, and they said the rest won't come until Friday.
M: Friday? The lunch is tomorrow at noon.
W: I know. Should we change the menu?
M: Let's see if Pacific Seafood can deliver today. I'll call them now. If they can't, we'll serve chicken instead and let the client know.

questions.content: What problem does the woman report?
questions.explanation: 'Half of the salmon we ordered is missing' → đơn hàng giao thiếu (incomplete).

questions.content: What does the man imply when he says, “The lunch is tomorrow at noon”?

options.A: He has not been informed about an event.
options.B: The kitchen staff should start early.
options.C: A delivery will arrive too late.
options.D: He wants to change the time of an event.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi hàm ý: phần cá còn lại tới thứ Sáu mới giao, trong khi bữa trưa là ngày mai → giao như vậy là quá muộn.

questions.content: What will the man most likely do next?
questions.explanation: 'Let's see if Pacific Seafood can deliver today. I'll call them now.' → liên hệ một nhà cung cấp khác. (A), (B) chỉ xảy ra nếu họ không giao được.

groups.transcript:
W: Excuse me, I'd like to order one of today's specials, but I don't eat meat.
M: Then I'd suggest either the vegetable curry or the seafood pasta.
W: Hmm, I had curry yesterday, so I'll try the pasta.
M: Good choice. Just so you know, the pasta takes about twenty minutes to prepare. Is that OK?
W: That's fine, but I need to be back at my office by one fifteen. Could I pay now so I don't have to wait for the bill later?
M: Of course. I'll bring the card machine right away.

questions.content: Why does the woman decide not to order the curry?

options.D: It takes too long to prepare.

questions.explanation: 'I had curry yesterday, so I'll try the pasta.' (D) là thông tin về món pasta, không phải món cà ri.

questions.content: Look at the graphic. How much will the woman pay for her meal?
questions.explanation: Cô ấy chọn Seafood Pasta; theo thực đơn, món này giá $16.

questions.content: What does the woman want to do?
questions.explanation: 'Could I pay now so I don't have to wait for the bill later?' → trả tiền trước.

groups.transcript: Are you looking for a place to hold your next business lunch? Come to Garden Terrace, located on the top floor of the Riverside Hotel. Our chef, who trained in Paris, prepares seasonal dishes using vegetables grown in our own rooftop garden. From Monday to Friday, we offer a two-course business lunch for just nineteen dollars. And this month only, groups of eight or more will receive a free dessert for every guest. Reservations can be made on our Web site.

questions.explanation: Quảng cáo nhà hàng Garden Terrace cho bữa trưa công việc. (C) chỉ là vị trí (nằm trên tầng thượng khách sạn).

questions.content: What is mentioned about the vegetables?

options.B: They are sold at a local market.
options.C: They are grown at the hotel.

questions.explanation: '…vegetables grown in our own rooftop garden' → trồng ngay tại khách sạn. (A) bẫy: đầu bếp học ở Paris, không phải rau nhập từ Pháp.

questions.content: What will groups of eight or more receive this month?
questions.explanation: 'Groups of eight or more will receive a free dessert for every guest.'

groups.transcript: Hello, Mr. Fischer. This is Anna from Taste Catering, returning your call about the company dinner on May tenth. You mentioned you'd like to add twenty more guests. We can certainly do that, but we'll need to bring two more servers. You also asked whether we could provide a vegan dessert. Our pastry chef makes a chocolate avocado cake. Most people don't believe it's vegan! I'll send you an updated quote this afternoon. Please sign it and return it by Wednesday so we can confirm the extra staff.

questions.content: What is the purpose of the message?

options.A: To respond to a request for changes
options.C: To ask for a late payment

questions.explanation: Người nói gọi lại để trả lời các yêu cầu của khách: thêm 20 khách và món tráng miệng thuần chay.

questions.content: Why does the speaker say, “Most people don't believe it's vegan”?

options.B: To express doubt about an ingredient

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi hàm ý: bánh ngon tới mức người ta không tin là thuần chay → cô đang giới thiệu/khuyên dùng món này.

questions.content: What does the speaker ask the listener to do by Wednesday?
questions.explanation: 'Please sign it and return it by Wednesday' – 'it' là bản báo giá (quote).

groups.transcript: Good afternoon, everyone. Before we open, here's a quick update. Tonight we have a party of twenty from Hanley Architects. They're celebrating the firm's tenth anniversary, and they'll be seated in the room between the window section and the entrance. Because it's a big group, Sofia and Liam will serve only that room this evening. Also, the owner has asked me to remind you that our new wine list starts tonight. Please take a few minutes to review it before the doors open at five.

questions.explanation: 'They're celebrating the firm's tenth anniversary' – firm = company.

questions.content: Look at the graphic. Where will the group be seated?
questions.explanation: Phòng nằm giữa Window Section và Entrance trên sơ đồ là Garden Room.

questions.content: What are the listeners asked to do before five o'clock?
questions.explanation: 'Please take a few minutes to review it (the new wine list) before the doors open at five.'
